name: Honoring Your Parents
overview: The Scriptures clearly command honoring one’s parents as a vital expression of obedience to God, promising a prolonged life and well-being in the land He gives (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16). This honor is not optional but mandated, with severe consequences for those who dishonor or curse their father or mother, including the judgment of death (Exodus 21:15; Leviticus 20:9). The call to fear and respect parents is coupled with reverence for God’s commandments, emphasizing the sacredness of the family relationship under the Lord’s authority (Leviticus 19:3). The Proverbs warn that cursing parents leads to spiritual darkness, underscoring the seriousness of this command (Proverbs 20:20).
